# Treasure › Precious Items

> Roll or select a number of items on this table as set by the treasure’s Value (`oracles/treasure/value/`). Each result represents a quantity of that item, such as a strongbox filled with pearls, barrels of aged rum, or a stack of precious metal ingots. To instead reveal a specific item of intrinsic or personal worth, check the Tokens (`oracles/treasure/tokens.md`) table.
